def: to dispart (the feet or lips), i.e. become licentious

occurrences.text: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
